Canonical scientific ledgers may change only at BATCH_COMMIT; findings land in a dossier and commit candidate.
The cancer mechanism does not support a new intervention hypothesis for the reference neurodevelopmental genotype.
The study tests no drug, dose or clinical treatment and its therapeutic-target wording remains prospective.
The operator set BLOCK_BATCH_COMMIT and prohibited edits to the four canonical scientific current files.

group_assessment.weighting: Europe PMC author counts measured 2026-08-10 returned 149 publications for Aqeilan RI and 79 intersecting WWOX. This is a primary mechanistic WWOX laboratory with deep conditional-model expertise. That strengthens confidence in execution and model context but does not turn same-lab prior ITCH work into an independently replicated mechanism; the present paper is weighted on its own genetic, imaging and molecular assays.

field_density.note: The cSCC intersection is sparse relative to broader p63 and EMT literatures. This study is unusually direct for conditional epidermal genetics, while the large broad full-text counts include secondary mentions and do not imply independent replication.

multihop.note: All 77 references were enumerated sequentially. PMID 23370280 is the load-bearing prior source for ITCH competition; PMID 32300104 and PMID 19465938 anchor related WWOX/EMT/Wnt context. The present read does not inherit their evidence status.

corpus_crossquery.query: Which current records are touched by conditional epidermal Wwox/p53 loss, EMT and the WWOX-p63 stabilization claim?
corpus_crossquery.note: Post-reading audit found FT-014 and existing WWOX cancer/mechanism surfaces. The queue's pdf_only label is obsolete because a complete structured PMC XML now exists. The paper adds primary context-dependent cSCC evidence, but direct ITCH competition remains prior-paper evidence.

retraction_check.result: Repository and Europe PMC checks on 2026-08-10 returned no retraction, expression of concern or correction for PMID 41984841.

verbatim_locators.source_fulltext_indexed_evidence: Europe PMC resolves PMID 41984841 to PMCID PMC13099603 and supplied a complete JATS body, six main figures and a supplementary archive; all cited local artifacts are fingerprinted.

entries.proposition: Wwox loss alone was insufficient for spontaneous tumour formation in the conditional model.
entries.snippet: Consistent with previous observations, somatic loss of WWOX alone was insufficient to drive tumor formation

entries.proposition: Wwox loss accelerated tumour incidence and onset in a p53-null background.
entries.snippet: 100% of mice developed tumors, with a median onset of 225 and 251 d, respectively, compared to 65% incidence and a median onset of 371 d in p53fl/fl group

entries.proposition: Chemical carcinogenesis exposed a tumour-promoting Wwox phenotype without engineered p53 loss.
entries.snippet: Wwoxfl/fl mice developed lesions earlier and in greater quantities compared to WT mice

entries.proposition: The DKO tumours contained epithelial, hybrid and mesenchymal states.
entries.snippet: tumors from DKO displayed marked heterogeneity, including epithelial and mesenchymal subpopulations, hybrid epithelial–mesenchymal cells

entries.proposition: Endogenous WWOX and p63 are proximal and occur in the same complex in the tested keratinocyte systems.
entries.snippet: These results indicate that WWOX and p63 are present within the same protein complex in cSCC cells.

entries.proposition: WWOX loss reduced p63 occupancy at epithelial target loci.
entries.snippet: WWOX deficiency led to a striking decrease in p63 occupancy at its major target loci, including promoters of epithelial identity genes such as KRT14, KRT5, KRT1, ITGB4, COL17A1, and FZD6

entries.proposition: The human tissue surface showed parallel reductions but does not itself establish prognosis or causality.
entries.snippet: IHC on tissue microarrays revealed that WWOX expression was strongly decreased in cSCC compared with normal epidermis

entries.proposition: Figure 1 visually shows context dependence and no clear Wwox allele-dose separation in the p53-null stratum.
entries.snippet: The p53fl/fl survival panel separates both Wwox-loss curves from Wwox-intact controls, while the heterozygous and homozygous Wwox-loss curves substantially overlap.
